prompt: Some people argue that all experimentation on animals is bad and should be outlawed. However, others believe that important scientific discoveries can be made from animal experiments. Can experimentation on animals be justified? Are there any alternatives?
essay:
Whether animals should be used for experiments and in laboratory research is a deeply debated issue. While animal testing has helped a lot of scientists with discoveries, the ethical concerns surrounding this topic have led to discussions for completely banning animal testing.

On the one hand, supporters argue that animal testing is beneficial and necessary for medical progress. Animals share a lot of biological similarities with humans, which is why they are ideal for experiments and testing how a drug or disease affects the body. For example, many of the cures have been tested on animals, such as vaccines, antibiotics and other treatments. From this point of view, doing research on animals is justified since it has saved millions of lives.

On the other hand, other people believe that since animals are beings that feel fear and pain, it is unethical and cruel to put them in laboratories and do all kinds of painful experiments on them. Furthermore, animals do not have the exact same biology as us humas, so a cure that works on mice might be ineffective or bad for the human body.

Fortunately, modern technology offers several alternatives that would help ban animal testing. Scientist can now test their discoveries on lab grown human cells instead of living animals. Additionally, artificial intelligence can predict the way the human body will react to different cures. Another way of testing treatments would be on human cadavers, this way scientists can do their research, surgical trials, and other complex anatomical studies without causing harm to living creatures.

To conclude, although animal experimentation played an important role in the past, today using the modern technology that we have, we have the option to completely ban animal testing.
